consequences.title: Before you continue
consequences.acknowledge: I understand the consequences and want to continue

items.profile: Your profile will be permanently deleted
items.rooms: You will leave every room you created or joined
items.devices: All devices will be signed out and your end-to-end keys will be invalidated
items.backup: Your key backup will no longer restore old messages

hints.profile: Display name, avatar and bio cannot be recovered
hints.rooms: Other members keep the messages they already received
hints.devices: Unverified history will no longer be decryptable
hints.backup: Make sure you no longer need those messages

verify.title: Verify your identity
verify.instruction: Type your full Matrix ID to confirm
verify.mismatch: That does not match the current account

final.title: Final confirmation
final.warning: This is the last step; the account is deactivated immediately after
final.erase: Also erase server-side data (cannot be undone)
final.dialog_message: This cannot be undone. Permanently deactivate this account?
